2607.02210.title: Criticality-Based Guard Rail Validation for AI Agent Decisions in Autonomous Telecom Networks
2607.02210.paper_summary: The evolution toward fully autonomous telecommunications networks (Autonomous Network Levels 4-5) requires AI/ML agents to make real-time network decisions without human intervention. However, no standardized runtime mechanism exists to intercept and validate individual inference outputs before they trigger live network state changes, creating risks of erroneous autonomous decisions. This paper proposes the Guard Rail Validation (GRV) framework, a standardizable runtime architecture for intercepting and validating AI-driven decisions before execution. The framework evaluates decisions across multiple weighted dimensions -- including action scope, action type, service criticality, agent autonomy level, reversibility, and temporal behavioural patterns -- to determine a criticality level. Based on this level, graduated validation mechanisms are applied: execute-with-logging, bounds checking, independent agent validation, or multi-agent consensus. The framework additionally provides cross-agent conflict detection with criticality-weighted priority resolution and runtime conformance logging for regulatory compliance (e.g., EU AI Act Article 14). We present the architecture, algorithmic procedures, O-RAN deployment model, and evaluate threat coverage against known AI/ML attacks in telecommunications.
2607.02210.paper_summary_zh: 完全自主的電信網絡（自主網絡等級4-5）的演進需要AI/ML代理在沒有人工干預的情況下做出實時網絡決策。<lb/>然而，沒有標準化的運行時機制來攔截和驗證個別推斷輸出，這會在它們觸發實時網絡狀態變更之前產生錯誤自主決策的風險。<lb/>本文提出了Guard Rail Validation (GRV)框架，這是一種可標準化的運行時架構，用於在執行之前攔截和驗證AI驅動的決策。<lb/>該框架在多個加權維度上評估決策——包括行動範圍、行動類型、服務關鍵性、代理自主性水平、可逆性和時間行為模式——以確定關鍵性水平。<lb/>根據這一水平，應用漸進式驗證機制：執行並記錄、邊界檢查、獨立代理驗證或多代理共識。<lb/>該框架還提供跨代理衝突檢測，並以關鍵性加權的優先級解決方案和運行時合規日誌來滿足監管要求（例如，歐盟AI法第14條）。<lb/>我們展示了架構、算法程序、O-RAN部署模型，並評估了對已知AI/ML攻擊的威脅覆蓋。
2607.02210.author: Ravi Kant Sharma et.al.
